description: Make one bound org (org: its alias, username or 18- or 15-character org id; required) the default that every Salesforce verb uses when a request names no org. The default is stored in the plugin's vault index together with the bindings, in one write. With a single bound org that org is always used; with several and no default, a request without org is refused with the list of bound orgs. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Choose which connected Salesforce org this solet uses when a request does not say, for example switching the default from production to a sandbox or scratch org while testing. The other connected orgs stay available by alias.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion: org (the alias), org_id and default true.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the new default org by alias and username, since later requests without an org go to it.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Change the default bound Salesforce org.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: org is missing. sf.unknown_org: org matches no bound org (the message lists them). sf.org_registry_failed: the vault index could not be read or written.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Pick an org from list_orgs, or bind it first with bind_org or login.
